Package dao

Class HotelDAO

java.lang.Object
dao.HotelDAO
public class HotelDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) for hotel, suite class, suite, and guest experience operations in the MIRAGE system.

This is the broadest DAO in the system, covering the entire hotel-property domain. It is used primarily by HotelSuiteScreen to register and browse hotels, suite classes, and individual suites. It is also used by other DAOs and screens that need to look up hotel-related metadata.

Responsibilities

  • Full CRUD for Hotel records
  • Insert and query SuiteClass records
  • Insert Suite records
  • Query GuestExperience records by hotel
  • Aggregate queries (total suites, hotel count by location)

  • Method Details

    • insertHotel

      public void insertHotel(Hotel hotel) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new hotel record into the hotel table and writes the generated primary key back to the supplied Hotel object.

      SQL executed:

      
   INSERT INTO hotel (name, theme, location, total_suites) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      Parameters:
      hotel - the Hotel to persist; must have a non-null name
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during insertion

    • updateHotel

      public void updateHotel(Hotel hotel) throws SQLException
      Updates all mutable fields of an existing hotel record.

      SQL executed:

      
   UPDATE hotel SET name=?, theme=?, location=?, total_suites=?
   WHERE hotel_id=?
      Parameters:
      hotel - the Hotel with updated values; hotelId must match an existing record
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the hotel ID does not exist or a database error occurs

    • deleteHotel

      public void deleteHotel(int hotelId) throws SQLException
      Deletes a hotel record by its primary key.

      Warning: This will fail with a FK violation if any suites, concierge staff, or guest experiences still reference this hotel. Those child records must be removed first.

      SQL executed:

      
   DELETE FROM hotel WHERE hotel_id = ?
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel to delete; must be positive
      Throws:
      SQLException - if child records exist (FK violation) or a database error occurs

    • getHotelById

      public Hotel getHotelById(int hotelId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves a single hotel by its primary key.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT * FROM hotel WHERE hotel_id = ?
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel to look up; must be positive
      Returns:
      the matching Hotel, or null if not found
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getAllHotels

      public List<Hotel> getAllHotels() throws SQLException
      Retrieves all hotel records, ordered by hotel_id ascending.

      Used to populate the hotel table in HotelSuiteScreen and the hotel combo boxes in other screens.

      SQL executed:

    • getHotelsByLocation

      public List<Hotel> getHotelsByLocation(String location) throws SQLException
      Retrieves hotels whose location contains the given substring (case-insensitive).

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT * FROM hotel WHERE location LIKE ? ORDER BY name
      Parameters:
      location - the location substring to search for; must not be null
      Returns:

      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

      public List<Hotel> getHotelsByTheme(String theme) throws SQLException

    • getHotelSuiteClasses

      public List<SuiteClass> getHotelSuiteClasses(int hotelId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves the distinct suite classes used by suites within a specific hotel.

      Results are ordered by nightly rate ascending so the cheapest tier appears first.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT DISTINCT sc.class_id, sc.class_name, sc.nightly_rate, sc.amenities
   FROM suite_class sc
   JOIN suite s ON s.class_id = sc.class_id
   WHERE s.hotel_id = ?
   ORDER BY sc.nightly_rate
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel to filter by; must be positive
      Returns:
      a List of SuiteClass objects used in that hotel; empty if the hotel has no suites or suite classes
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • insertSuite

      public void insertSuite(Suite suite) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new suite record into the suite table.

      SQL executed:

      
   INSERT INTO suite (hotel_id, class_id, suite_number) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
      Parameters:
      suite - the Suite to persist; must have valid hotelId, classId, and a non-blank suiteNumber
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the hotel or class ID does not exist (FK violation) or a database error occurs

    • getTotalSuitesAcrossAllHotels

      public int getTotalSuitesAcrossAllHotels() throws SQLException
      Returns the sum of total_suites across all hotel records.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT SUM(total_suites) AS total_suites FROM hotel
      Returns:
      the total suite count across all hotels; 0 if no hotels exist
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getHotelCountByLocation

      public List<Object[]> getHotelCountByLocation() throws SQLException
      Returns a breakdown of hotel count and total suites grouped by location.

      Each element in the returned list is an Object[] with three entries: [location (String), hotel_count (int), total_suites (int)].

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS hotel_count, SUM(total_suites) AS total_suites
   FROM hotel
   GROUP BY location
   ORDER BY location
      Returns:
      a List of Object[] rows; empty if no hotels exist
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • hotelExists

      public boolean hotelExists(int hotelId) throws SQLException
      Checks whether a hotel with the given ID exists in the database.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hotel WHERE hotel_id = ?
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID to check; must be positive
      Returns:
      true if a record exists; false otherwise
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getHotelsWithMinSuites

      public List<Hotel> getHotelsWithMinSuites(int minSuites) throws SQLException
      Retrieves hotels that have at least the specified number of suites, ordered by suite count descending (largest first).

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT * FROM hotel WHERE total_suites >= ? ORDER BY total_suites DESC
      Parameters:
      minSuites - the minimum number of suites required; must be non-negative
      Returns:
      a List of matching Hotel objects; empty if none qualify
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query

    • getExperiencesByHotel

      public List<GuestExperience> getExperiencesByHotel(int hotelId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves all guest experiences offered by a specific hotel, ordered alphabetically by experience name.

      SQL executed:

      
   SELECT ge.experience_id, ge.hotel_id, ge.experience_name,
          ge.description, ge.base_cost
   FROM guest_experience ge
   WHERE ge.hotel_id = ?
   ORDER BY ge.experience_name
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel to query experiences for; must be positive
      Returns:
      a List of GuestExperience objects at that hotel; empty if the hotel has no defined experiences
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database error occurs during the query
